title: Mass tourism and quiet escapes
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a tömegturizmusról és a fenntartható utazásról.

scenes.description: Thousands of tourists are crowding the narrow streets of a famous old town by the sea on a hot August afternoon. A huge cruise ship is anchored in the harbour, and a tour guide is holding up a yellow umbrella for her group. People are taking selfies in front of a historic church, and souvenir shops line the street. A local woman with heavy shopping bags is trying to get through the crowd, looking annoyed.

A family is staying at a small eco-farm in the hills of a quiet Hungarian region. The parents and their two children are picking apples in an orchard with the farmer, who is explaining something to them. There is a small guesthouse with solar panels on the roof in the background, and bicycles are leaning against the fence. There are no other tourists in sight.

prompts: Compare the two types of tourism and their effects on the places and the people.
What problems can mass tourism cause for local residents?
How could tourism become more sustainable?
followUpQuestions: Should popular cities limit the number of tourists? How could they do it?
Why do most people still choose famous destinations rather than quiet places?
What are the benefits of rural tourism for small villages in Hungary?
Do you think travelling will become a luxury again in the future? Why?
